text: Westport Albion gains control near the halfway line at the left side, advancing the ball directly and quickly through the central midfield into Kingsmoor FC’s defensive third at the far end. They make five entries into this final third over eight minutes, using vertical passes up the middle to bypass wide areas. Westport’s forward, Rafael Delacroix, rises to head a shot at goal just inside the penalty area on the left flank, but the keeper blocks it, keeping the score level at 2-2. This moment highlights Westport’s shift from wide play to focused, direct attacks aiming to unsettle Kingsmoor’s defense.
